- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Emancipation Proclamation declared that all slaves in Confederate states would be considered free.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Emancipation Proclamation paved the way for the 13th Amendment to the US Constitution, which abolished slavery in the United States.
